reference.hostWorkloadBoundary: Vue and Foldkit use the same public document fixtures and operation counts. Minimap rows are Vanilla-only because neither host exposes a minimap in the current public host contract. Foldkit records the 4000-node workload without culling because that host has no render-only-visible option.
